title: Multimodal AI Detection for Math-Heavy Scientific Text
abstract: arXiv:2610.21062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models become increasingly capable of generating, and assisting with, scientific writing, there is a need for greater transparency and disclosure around the use of AI in research. Consequently, a veritable subfield of research and a number of commercial services aim to flag AI-generated content automatically. However, existing detectors which rely only on text extracted from PDFs fail to benefit from the rich visual information contained in the formatting of math-heavy scientific content. translated_title: 面向数学密集型科学文本的多模态AI检测
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型在生成和辅助科学写作方面的能力日益增强，研究者在使用AI进行研究时需要更高的透明度和信息披露。因此，一个专门的研究子领域以及众多商业服务应运而生，旨在自动标记AI生成的内容。然而，现有仅依赖于从PDF中提取文本的检测器，无法利用数学密集型科学内容排版格式中所包含的丰富视觉信息。为研究这一问题，我们从2022年之前的arXiv LaTeX源文件中选取人类撰写的证明和正文段落，并在同一篇论文的上下文中使用15个现代大语言模型重新生成这些内容。这使得我们获得了三种不同表示形式下的人机配对输出：LaTeX源代码、PDF渲染图像以及从PDF中提取的文本。我们发现，最先进的Pangram 4的检测准确率随着数学内容……（摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了包含LaTeX源码、PDF渲染图像和提取文本三种表示形式的人机配对科学文本数据集，发现仅依赖文本的AI检测器在数学密集型内容上准确率显著下降，证明了利用多模态视觉信息对检测AI生成的科学文本至关重要。
en_tdlr: This study builds a dataset of coupled human-AI scientific text in three representations (LaTeX source, rendered PDF images, and extracted text), revealing that text-only AI detectors suffer significant accuracy drops on math-heavy content, demonstrating the importance of multimodal visual information for detecting AI-generated scientific text.
